title: After a host move the plain CLI still passes the version check
description: A temporary install's CLI release worktree and managed checkout are copied to a second directory standing in for a new host, with hostId re-pointed and the source checkout the release's .git names gone. status GY-1 --json from the copied checkout succeeds against the server; with the release identity file removed, the refusal names the file and the repair command, and running it makes status succeed. A CLI really older than the server is still refused.

steps.name: Run the copied CLI release against the server before and after removing its identity file
